verdicts.label: contradicted
verdicts.reason: The cancel_order(7731) call returned an ERROR stating the order is out_for_delivery and can no longer be cancelled, directly conflicting with the claim that it was cancelled.

verdicts.claim: A refund will be processed for the order.
verdicts.label: ungrounded
verdicts.reason: No tool result in the trajectory returns any refund information; get_order only returned items and status, and cancel_order returned an error with no refund field.
